prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1374; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was backing out of a parking space at a shopping center in Sugar Land, Texas, moving slowly with my mirrors checked, when the other vehicle came around the end of the row and struck the rear passenger side of my car. The impact was not severe, but my head snapped against the window frame and I felt dizzy and nauseous within minutes. I was taken to an urgent care clinic, where I was told I had a concussion and was advised to rest and avoid screens for several days. Since then I have had headaches and trouble concentrating. Looking back, I have remembered a few smaller details, such as the color of the other car and the position of a shopping cart near my door, but the core of what happened has not changed since I first described it. I am the named driver on this policy and have provided my insurance information below.
